message.content: According to the data, Evangeline discusses Real Madrid's history in the Champions League, particularly mentioning the 2011 Champions League final where Barcelona defeated Real Madrid 3-1. She emphasizes the significance of this match by stating, "That 3-1 scoreline was so satisfying, and the way they controlled the game was just masterclass." Evangeline highlights the performances of Xavi and Iniesta during that match, noting that "Xavi and Iniesta were unplayable that day," underscoring the tactical prowess and overall dominance of Barcelona in that particular tournament.
